steps.instruction: Pour the salt solution into the evaporating basin.
Set up the tripod, gauze, and place the basin above the heat source.
Heat gently until water evaporates and salt crystals form.

rules.feedback: The salt solution fills the evaporating basin.
The heat source is positioned safely below the basin.
The water evaporates as vapor, leaving behind dry salt crystals.

outcomes.title: Salt recovered
outcomes.description: The water has completely evaporated, leaving dry salt crystals in the basin.

safeFailure.guidance: Ensure good ventilation and use appropriate heat settings.

narration.text: Pour the salt solution into the evaporating basin. The solution should fill about two thirds of the basin.
Set up a tripod with gauze above your heat source. Place the basin gently on the gauze.
Heat gently with a steady flame. The salt crystals will begin to form as water evaporates.
